subject: Orphan PO detected during vendor intake — request for spendcap recovery & line fixes
messages:
From: Kiran Shah <kiran.shah@blueyard.example.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding - BlueYard / initial PO request

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Thanks for taking BlueYard through Redwood's procurement flow — excited to get started. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding form and initial invoice schedule. We tried to map the purchase reference in our AP system to the PO you provided (PO# 87421) but our finance team reports the line items are being rejected: the SKU codes and quantities in their export don't match the PO line IDs returned from your API.

Quick notes from our side:
- We submitted the onboarding_form with PO# 87421 (see attachment).
- Spend cap for Q3 in our contract is $120,000; our systems currently show the full amount as available, but Redwood's API returned a different spend_bucket id which caused our payment pipeline to flag the put-through.
- One of our items shows up as "orphaned" in your return payload (line_id null) which prevents reconciliation.

Can someone confirm whether PO 87421 was created in the onboarding ledger and whether there are alternate serials or provisional PO tokens that BlueYard should use? We need this resolved before our first invoice on July 5.

Attachments: blueyard_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Kiran Shah
Head of Finance Operations
BlueYard Systems

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Kiran Shah <kiran.shah@blueyard.example.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - BlueYard / initial PO request

Monica — looping you in because this looks like an onboarding PO mapping edge case. Kiran, thanks for the details.

Summary of what I'm seeing from the intake logs: PO 87421 was provisionally issued on 2027-06-25 but the tokenization step failed for one line (SKU: BY-DB-11) and produced a tombstoned line with no external line_id. That is why your AP export is treating it as orphaned. The spend_bucket id mismatch is likely because our provisional reservation used a temporary spendcap token (spendcap_token: sc-pt-992) that should have been reconciled to the canonical bucket (spend_bucket: sb-quarterly-120k) after finalize — it appears that finalize did not run for that record.

Can procurement run a reconciliation on provisional PO tokens from 2027-06-24 to 2027-06-27 and re-issue a finalized PO (or map a fallback canonical spend_bucket) for 87421? If possible, we should also: 
- stitch the tombstoned line BY-DB-11 back to the canonical line_id and correct the quantity (vendor submitted quantity: 50; the PO shows 5)
- temporarily lift the hold so their invoice scheduled for July 5 can pass (we can take a manual approval and then reverse if required)

Kiran — to keep things moving, please confirm the invoice line-level details (SKU, qty, unit price) in the attached ticket so Monica can validate.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Monica runs provisional-token reconciliation and re-issues a finalized PO or issues a short-term fallback spend_bucket mapping.
2) Monica attaches a reconciliation sheet with the corrected line_id mapping and marks "manual approve for first invoice" if she wants us to lift the hold.
3) Aditya will coordinate with Finance to ensure the manual approval tracks as a one-off and that spendcap accounting backfills.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Kiran Shah <kiran.shah@blueyard.example.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - BlueYard / initial PO request

Thanks for the clear triage notes. I pulled the provisional token ledger and ran the tokenization reconciliation for 2027-06-24 through 06-27. Findings and actions: 

Findings:
- Provisional token sc-pt-992 existed but never reconciled to spend_bucket sb-quarterly-120k due to a transient DB race during the finalize job (we tracked this to a delayed consumer on queue procurement-finalize-2).
- Line BY-DB-11 was uploaded with qty 50 (vendor manifest) but our onboarding packet contained the canonical vendor quantity of 5. System created a tombstone on ingestion because external_line_ref was empty.

Actions taken (attached po_reconciliation_sheet.csv):
- I re-mapped sc-pt-992 -> sb-quarterly-120k and forced a finalize for PO 87421.
- Reinstated line BY-DB-11 and corrected the quantity to 5 (we added a comment for BlueYard's AP to confirm).
- Issued an amended PO pdf (amended_po_87421.pdf) and flagged the record with "manual-approve-first-invoice" so payments can pass for July 5.

For audit, I left an itemized change log in the reconciliation sheet (row-level comments). Kiran — please confirm the corrected quantity and unit price for BY-DB-11 in the csv so I can close the loop.

I will also open a ticket to investigate the finalize consumer lag (item #PR-4987) and put in a short-term alert so we don't miss another finalize. Jordan — FYI; this is a small operational gap but worth tracking as a reliability item.

Attachments: po_reconciliation_sheet.csv (csv), amended_po_87421.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Kiran Shah <kiran.shah@blueyard.example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - BlueYard / initial PO request

Kiran — Monica finished the reconciliation and we've reissued an amended PO. Please confirm the following two items so we can close: 
1) Quantity and unit price for BY-DB-11 in the attached csv (Monica changed qty to 5; we left your vendor-submitted qty 50 as a note).
2) Confirmation that your AP can process the July 5 invoice against amended PO 87421 (manual-approve-first-invoice flag is set on our side).

Once you confirm, Monica will drop the manual flag into the audit trail and PR-4987 will track the finalize consumer fix. If anything blocks payment, I can authorize a one-off exception through Finance — but want to avoid that if possible.

Thanks for moving quickly on this.
Aditya
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
